description: Find, audition and place sound effects for a video (HyperFrames, Remotion, ffmpeg edits) with Openverse (api.openverse.org, CC0 sounds from Freesound). Covers copying the sound design of a reference video (the gemini subagent reads the media file and lists its effects and search terms), the openverse.ts CLI (search, get with credits, audition reel), picking by ear with the gemini subagent, trimming and normalizing with ffmpeg, syncing cues to visible actions, and Tommy's taste rules (a soft sound for every movement, no pops or high bells, a different whoosh for each scene), and mix levels for launch videos (-14 LUFS master for YouTube and X, voiceover pace and chain, music ducking, loudnorm and ebur128 commands). Use when the user asks for sound effects, sfx, sound design, whooshes, pops or clicks, a voiceover, or audio levels and loudness in a video.
